card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 7 Stuck In DFU Mode. iTunes Error Code 4014

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 7 Stuck In DFU Mode. iTunes Error Code 4014

claims.statement: iPhone 7 stuck in DFU with restore error 4014 (3uTools flash failing around 19%) usually means NAND not detected.
Check NAND-area capacitors for shorts first; otherwise pull the NAND and read it on a JC P7 programmer: unreadable = replace, readable = reball and refit.

procedure: Check capacitors around NAND for shorts; remove a shorted cap and retest.
Pull NAND and test on JC P7.
Replace dead NAND, or reball and refit a readable one.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
